findings.title: Current prices and availability
findings.reported_experience: D1 describes a delay between sales-stock updates and the website. Both buyers describe calling about a unit that was already unavailable or reserved.
findings.design_interpretation: The design retains one physical availability state, immediate valid updates and a current-state check before accepting an enquiry.

findings.title: Finishing and the full offered price
findings.reported_experience: All three accounts describe confusion about finishing labels or what the advertised price includes. B2 compares finishing cost and preparation effort for rental use.
findings.design_interpretation: Apartment details show the developer-defined base condition, a plain description and the full price of each optional offer. Comparison and enquiries retain the selected offer.

findings.title: A stable comparison of specific apartments
findings.reported_experience: B1 uses WhatsApp, screenshots and notes; B2 uses browser tabs, screenshots and Telegram. Both lose track of the selected offers and prioritise direct comparison.
findings.design_interpretation: Comparison retains each physical apartment, its development, price, floor, layout and selected finishing, including through guest sign-in.

findings.title: Apartment position and surroundings
findings.reported_experience: Both buyers describe plans that show rooms without explaining the unit position. They consider window orientation, road noise and nearby transport; B2 also considers universities and business areas.
findings.design_interpretation: Linked building, floor and apartment views provide orientation, location and saved infrastructure context.

findings.title: An enquiry with the selected apartment context
findings.reported_experience: D1 sometimes receives only a phone number and must rediscover the selected unit. Both buyers prefer an enquiry about a particular apartment and describe unwanted follow-up calls.
findings.design_interpretation: The enquiry retains unit, finishing and submitted-price context in the owning inbox and buyer history, with processing status. Written replies remain outside the current baseline.

findings.title: Gradual preparation and simple updates
findings.reported_experience: D1 reports that stock, plans and marketing images arrive separately, requests private drafting and wants to know when edits become public.
findings.design_interpretation: The publication workflow combines section-by-section private saving, a complete first-publication check and immediate valid updates afterwards.

findings.title: Reviewed image-to-record links
findings.reported_experience: D1 describes separate architectural/design files and the risk of opening the wrong apartment. The participant coordinates sales information and does not personally prepare the image regions.
findings.design_interpretation: Publication requires developer correction and explicit record assignment. Region quality and editing effort have separate evaluation criteria.

findings.title: Explainable recommendations that buyers can check
findings.reported_experience: Both buyers would try natural-language search but would inspect the price, location and plan themselves. B2 asks for reasons behind an investment-related suggestion.
findings.design_interpretation: Explanations use catalogue facts, backend checks enforce hard constraints, and condition changes require buyer confirmation. Rental-return prediction is outside the current baseline.

quotes.quote: Prices are in one file, plans are in another folder, and pictures are somewhere else.
I had a lot of screenshots, and I didn't remember which apartment was from which developer.
Show me why you think it's good.

additional_requests.reported_need: D1 requests Excel-based upload and objects to entering a large stock manually.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: Bulk editing already exists in FR-22. Import needs a separate decision on template, validation, duplicates and partial errors.

additional_requests.reported_need: B2 asks to see when a price was updated.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: Current-state rechecking remains mandatory. A public timestamp is a separate presentation enhancement and does not guarantee freshness by itself.

additional_requests.reported_need: B1 asks to save apartments without creating an account immediately.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: Keep guest comparison in FR-02/13 and verified sign-in for favourites in FR-02/14. Guest favourites would change the approved access rule.

additional_requests.reported_need: Both buyers prefer a question and answer about the selected apartment over unrelated sales calls.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: The current enquiry includes a comment, contact data and status history. In-account replies or a preferred response channel need a separate workflow decision.

additional_requests.request: Price per square metre in comparison
additional_requests.reported_need: B2 suggests this as an additional comparison value.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: Consider a derived price/area metric alongside the approved full price; it must not replace finishing and total-cost information.

additional_requests.reported_need: B2 wants to compare spending with potential rental income and similar local rents.
additional_requests.scope_assessment: Treat rental use as buyer context. Rental-income estimates need an additional data source, method and scope decision; no yield claim follows from this transcript.
